A particle of mass m moves in a circular orbit under the central potential field $(r) = - \frac{C}{r}$ , where C is a positive constant. The correct radius-velocity graph of the particle motion is:
![](asset:P000513-stem-1)

assets.alt: Four graphs (A) to (D) with v on the horizontal axis: (A) a curve falling steeply and then flattening; (B) a curve rising more and more steeply; (C) a straight line through the origin; (D) a quarter-circle shape falling from the vertical axis to the horizontal axis.
